001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr;
002
003import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
004
005import jdk.jfr.Category;
006import jdk.jfr.Description;
007import jdk.jfr.Enabled;
008import jdk.jfr.Event;
009import jdk.jfr.Label;
010import jdk.jfr.Name;
011import jdk.jfr.StackTrace;
012
013/**
014 * Base JFR event committed by {@link JfrLogOutput}, one concrete subclass per SLF4J /
015 * {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level}, so each level can be independently
016 * enabled/disabled and thresholded through a Flight Recorder configuration ({@code .jfc})
017 * the same way any other JFR event type can.
018 * <p>
019 * Deliberately not shared with {@link JfrAlertListener}, which commits its own, separate
020 * {@link RainbowGumAlertEvent} instead - see that class for why.
021 * <p>
022 * {@link #throwable} is a plain formatted stack trace string rather than JFR's own
023 * {@code @StackTrace} capture: that JFR feature records the stack at the point
024 * {@link Event#commit()} is called (i.e. inside this module), which is not useful here,
025 * so it is disabled ({@link StackTrace @StackTrace(false)}) and the logged
026 * {@link Throwable}, if any, is captured as a field instead.
027 * <p>
028 * MDC / key values have no field of their own - {@link JfrLogOutput}'s encoder renders
029 * them directly into {@link #message} instead, since JFR custom event fields are limited
030 * to primitives, {@link String}, {@link Class} and {@link Thread}, so there is no direct
031 * representation for an arbitrary map.
032 */
033@Category("Rainbow Gum")
034@StackTrace(false)
035public abstract sealed class RainbowGumLogEvent extends Event {
036
037        /**
038         * The already-formatted log message, or null if there was none.
039         */
040        @Label("Message")
041        public @Nullable String message;
042
043        /**
044         * The logger name, or null if unavailable.
045         */
046        @Label("Logger")
047        public @Nullable String logger;
048
049        /**
050         * The logged throwable formatted as a stack trace string, or null if none was logged.
051         */
052        @Label("Throwable")
053        public @Nullable String throwable;
054
055        RainbowGumLogEvent() {
056        }
057
058        /**
059         * Creates the concrete event subclass matching {@code level}, or null if there is
060         * none (JFR events are all-or-nothing per level, not filterable by
061         * {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#ALL}/{@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#OFF}).
062         * @param level level.
063         * @return new, uncommitted event instance, or null.
064         */
065        static @Nullable RainbowGumLogEvent of(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
066                return switch (level) {
067                        case TRACE -> new TraceEvent();
068                        case DEBUG -> new DebugEvent();
069                        case INFO -> new InfoEvent();
070                        case WARNING -> new WarnEvent();
071                        case ERROR -> new ErrorEvent();
072                        case ALL, OFF -> null;
073                };
074        }
075
076        /**
077         * TRACE level event. Disabled by default ({@link Enabled @Enabled(false)}) since
078         * TRACE logging is typically too high volume to want on by default in a recording.
079         */
080        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.Trace")
081        @Label("Trace")
082        @Description("A TRACE level Rainbow Gum log event.")
083        @Enabled(false)
084        public static final class TraceEvent extends RainbowGumLogEvent {
085
086                /**
087                 * Created by {@link JfrLogOutput}.
088                 */
089                TraceEvent() {
090                }
091
092        }
093
094        /**
095         * DEBUG level event. Disabled by default ({@link Enabled @Enabled(false)}) since
096         * DEBUG logging is typically too high volume to want on by default in a recording.
097         */
098        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.Debug")
099        @Label("Debug")
100        @Description("A DEBUG level Rainbow Gum log event.")
101        @Enabled(false)
102        public static final class DebugEvent extends RainbowGumLogEvent {
103
104                /**
105                 * Created by {@link JfrLogOutput}.
106                 */
107                DebugEvent() {
108                }
109
110        }
111
112        /**
113         * INFO level event.
114         */
115        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.Info")
116        @Label("Info")
117        @Description("An INFO level Rainbow Gum log event.")
118        public static final class InfoEvent extends RainbowGumLogEvent {
119
120                /**
121                 * Created by {@link JfrLogOutput}.
122                 */
123                InfoEvent() {
124                }
125
126        }
127
128        /**
129         * WARN level event.
130         */
131        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.Warn")
132        @Label("Warn")
133        @Description("A WARN level Rainbow Gum log event.")
134        public static final class WarnEvent extends RainbowGumLogEvent {
135
136                /**
137                 * Created by {@link JfrLogOutput}.
138                 */
139                WarnEvent() {
140                }
141
142        }
143
144        /**
145         * ERROR level event.
146         */
147        @Name("io.jstach.rainbowgum.Error")
148        @Label("Error")
149        @Description("An ERROR level Rainbow Gum log event.")
150        public static final class ErrorEvent extends RainbowGumLogEvent {
151
152                /**
153                 * Created by {@link JfrLogOutput}.
154                 */
155                ErrorEvent() {
156                }
157
158        }
159
160}
